Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) is a government agency responsible for conducting civil services examinations in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India.
The commission was established in 1937 and is headquartered in Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh.

The UPPSC Assistant Professor GDC Recruitment 2025 is a government job opportunity for master degree holders in related subjects.
